---
title: "NHIS: Adults Who Have Sought Out Acupuncture"
author: "Tony Beal"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---
\
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE,}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
acu_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  select(ACUYR, ACUPAIN) 

p_acuyr <- ggplot(acu_df, aes(factor(ACUYR, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#6BABD6", color = "#243845", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ACUYR", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 30000), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 30000, by = 5000)
    ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ACUYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of acupuncture?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt"))
  )

acu_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(ACUPAIN != 0) |> 
  select(ACUPAIN) 

p_acupain <- ggplot(acu_pain_df, aes(factor(ACUPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#6BABD6", color = "#243845", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 525), 
                     breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 550, by = 50)
                     ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of acupuncture \nto treat or manage physical pain?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt")),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )

p_acuyr + p_acupain

```

ACUYR *"During the past 12 months, did you see a practitioner of acupuncture?"*\
```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
acu_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ACUYR, 2)
acu_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ACUYR, 1)

acu_yes # n = 665
acu_no # n = 25913 
# total  27,651

acuyr_per <- getPercentage(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ACUYR, 2)

```

Yes: `r acu_yes`\
No: `r acu_no`\
`r acuyr_per` of adults in our sample have answered 'yes' to having had acupuncture in the past 12 months\
\
\
ACUPAIN *"During the past 12 months, did you see a practitioner of acupuncture to treat or manage physical pain?" *\
```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
acu_pain_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ACUPAIN, 2)
acu_pain_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ACUPAIN, 1)

# 0f the adults who answered 'yes' to ACUYR above
acu_pain_yes # n = 502 
acu_pain_no # n = 163

acu_pain_per <- (acu_pain_yes / acu_yes)*100


# here I am filtering out the values that are 0 or NIU so that they don't 
# show up in the plot
```

Yes: `r acu_pain_yes`\
No: `r acu_pain_no`\
`r round(acu_pain_per, 1)`% of the 665 people who answered yes to using acupuncture in the past year, reported seeing an acupuncturist for pain management.\
\
